review_basis: Source-assisted review of organizational referents: compare the retained FEC name, captured item label/description/website and the independent first-party source below. Labels are benchmark annotations, not generated by the resolver. They do not establish a unique legal registration or transaction-time employment. All unlabeled query/QID pairs remain unreviewed, including related umbrella and historical unions.
scope: Diagnostic corpus from the first twenty distinct nonblank 2024 connected-organization strings in lexical order. Five queries completed; a Wikipedia HTTP 429 stopped the remaining requests. Only two query referents and two distinct counterexamples are reviewed. This is not a representative or held-out population sample and cannot establish production precision or recall.

The captured 1199 page is explicitly a Wikimedia disambiguation page, not the healthcare union identified by the official source. It is not a singleton organization identity. This annotation says nothing about the separate umbrella/historical-union candidates, which remain unreviewed.

The official 2024 announcement explicitly names the corporation. The captured 1st Source item describes a financial-services company and links to its official domain. This is the reviewed organization referent behind the shortened item name. The bank subsidiary and the corporation are not thereby merged; the shared site is not sufficient for production legal-entity verification.
The captured item is a source-to-source compiler concept. The first-party page identifies a named financial corporation. Shared occurrences of the word source are not organization identity evidence.
